review_mode: fresh independent read-only source and recorded-evidence review; no native browser replay

verdict_a_spec.terminal_saved_current: Source gate requires the exact generated recipe header, exact current-only preview, live exact-row Run control settled, and no pane error or unavailable observation (showcase-d47-saved-result.mjs:2-93; showcase-d47-terminal-budget.mjs:179-225). This is source-supported, native-unverified.
verdict_a_spec.observer_cleanup: PARTIAL: normal installed path removes and confirms the listener inside exercisePanel before harness teardown (showcase-d47-document-lifecycle.mjs:216-243,350-360; native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs:1391-1477). A lost installation acknowledgement can leave the listener installed but marked uninstalled; cleanup then detaches without removal.
verdict_a_spec.owned_recipe_cleanup: Source path records a unique generated name and host before save, targets the exact visible row and confirmation title, and waits for its absence in a loaded host list before browser teardown (showcase-d47-document-lifecycle.mjs:168-214,493-504). This is source-supported, native-unverified.
verdict_a_spec.failure_preservation: Exercise error remains primary; observer and recipe cleanup failures are recorded and prevent a clean pass when there was no earlier failure (showcase-d47-document-lifecycle.mjs:216-243).
verdict_a_spec.native_acceptance: UNVERIFIED: the builder report contains controlled Chromium DOM and driver guard evidence only. A fresh signed-in installed-artifact replay is still required; guards alone never establish user-visible terminal output or persisted cleanup.

verdict_b_quality.positive: The terminal predicate uses exact-row DOM state instead of body-wide progress text; the reported 8/8 DOM and 14/14 driver guards include constant-success and interim-success mutants that fail as expected (.research/d47-completion-cleanup-fix-20261007.json). Cleanup is inside the harness callback and preserves the first error.
verdict_b_quality.finding: Important: listener installation is not atomic with probeInstalled. Runtime.evaluate installs chrome.debugger.onEvent listener and global probe before acknowledgement (showcase-d47-document-lifecycle.mjs:293-340); probeInstalled becomes true only after the awaited call returns (same file:621-625). If CDP applies the evaluation but drops its reply, withD47Cleanup calls cleanupD47Probe(worker,false), which skips remove and merely detaches (showcase-d47-driver-evidence.mjs:22-35). This violates confirmed observer removal before teardown on a realistic partial failure.
verdict_b_quality.test_gap: New tests cover the terminal helper and existing probe cleanup when installed=true/false, but do not force the partial-install acknowledgement failure through the real driver lifecycle. The recorded guard results do not close this gap.

open_items: Repair and force-test partial observer installation so cleanup checks/removes an existing listener even when installation acknowledgement is lost, while preserving the primary failure.

Run fresh signed-in native acceptance on a current installed artifact and verify exact user-visible terminal result, observer removal, and run-owned recipe absence. Broader D47/T57 acceptance remains open.
